title: Flat precomposition transformation for right-adjoint base change
statement: In a cartesian square of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes X'=X\times_Y Y' with g_X:X'\to X, f':X'\to Y', f:X\to Y, and g:Y'\to Y [def-pc-fibre-product], with Y=\operatorname{Spec}(A) and Y'=\operatorname{Spec}(A') affine, let a and a' be right adjoints to Rf_* and Rf'_* on quasi-coherent derived categories [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-direct-image], and assume the canonical base-change transformation \beta:Lg^*Rf_*\to Rf'_*Lg_X^* of [def-sc-duality-equation-base-change-map] is an isomorphism. Let M\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X), K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y), and let c:Lg_X^*a(K)\to a'(Lg^*K) be the canonical morphism of [def-sc-duality-equation-base-change-map]. Write (-,-)_Z for the global derived Hom complex [def-pc-global-derived-rhom] and -\otimes A' for -\otimes^{\mathbf L}_AA'. Then the two morphisms (M,a(K))_X\otimes A'\to(Lg_X^*M,a'(Lg^*K))_{X'} in D(A') agree: the first is the comparison (M,a(K))_X\otimes A'\to(Lg_X^*M,Lg_X^*a(K))_{X'} induced by derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback] followed by (Lg_X^*M,c)_{X'}; the second is the composite of the adjunction isomorphism (M,a(K))_X\cong(Rf_*M,K)_Y [lem-pc-global-hom-adjunction], the algebraic RHom base-change map (Rf_*M,K)_Y\otimes A'\to(Lg^*Rf_*M,Lg^*K)_{Y'} (adjoint to the map induced by Lg^*), the isomorphism induced by \beta_M^{-1}:Rf'_*Lg_X^*M\to Lg^*Rf_*M, and the adjunction isomorphism (Rf'_*Lg_X^*M,Lg^*K)_{Y'}\cong(Lg_X^*M,a'(Lg^*K))_{X'} [lem-pc-global-hom-adjunction].
